inputs.commit_message: sync: unify staged fixes with main
inputs.shell_command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin main agent-request/chatgpt; set +e; git merge --no-commit --no-ff origin/agent-request/chatgpt; rc=$?; set -e; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then conflicts=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U); [ -n "$conflicts" ] || exit $rc; for f in $conflicts; do case "$f" in .agent-control/requests/*|.github/workflows/asol-production-cutover.yml) git checkout --ours -- "$f"; git add -- "$f" ;; *) echo "UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT=$f"; exit 42 ;; esac; done; fi; test -z "$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)"; echo "MERGE_READY=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"; git status --short
